purpose: Evaluate a hiring-challenge prototype, not certify production or a grade.

dimensions.correctness: Claims agree with trustworthy public sources or explicitly synthetic tool observations; preserve conditions, dates, product and market.
dimensions.relevance: Addresses the actual request, not just a related source or product.
dimensions.completeness: Answers every requested supported part; identifies unsupported parts without inventing or silently omitting them.
dimensions.groundedness: Visible claims are supported by the supplied sources, not merely accompanied by URLs.
dimensions.usefulness: Provides an actionable answer or a necessary clarification; unwarranted refusal of a supported task is a failure.

labels.not_assessable: Evidence insufficient; never counts as pass

independence: Blind judge receives request, permitted conversation, visible response and independently selected public references. It does not receive expected answer, oracle criteria, split, case ID, model identity, version label or previous grade. Another model or agent is not proof of independence or truth.
holdout: Freeze before output collection. Once inspected for correction, the case becomes known regression. Record exposure in run artifacts. Public repository visibility does not guarantee permanent blindness.
failure_policy: Preserve every attempt. No replacement of poor runs, automatic retries, fallback providers or rewriting the oracle to match output. Compare the same frozen revision; a correction creates a new revision, not a continuation of the old benchmark.
modes: Report controlled, deterministic_local and model_real separately. HTTP success, valid citations, repetition agreement and unit test totals are not semantic quality.
sources: Reference groups must resolve to reviewed local public corpus bytes; dynamic public information requires dated live evidence. Synthetic account data and workflow effects need separate trusted observations. Text alone cannot prove authorization, a write, or human participation.
budget: No paid calls authorized by this protocol. Later explicit round approval must cap all supervisor, planner, draft, verifier and independent-judge calls, tokens and total money. A scenario is not a provider call.
reproduction: Freeze code/corpus/dataset/oracles/protocol hashes, endpoint, configuration and model/pricing evidence. Keep full sanitized answers and all failures outside the repository. CI is offline only; YAML presence is not proof of a hosted run.
